proposal: Keep 16.0 degC as the contractual reference (our guarantees are priced on it); the measured data is used for the condenser/CW design range only.
question: ER-02.03 and ER-07.08 fix the Site Reference seawater temperature at 16.0 degC. ALP-OWN-MAR-001 section 3 gives a measured annual mean of 15.4 degC at the intake depth. Which value is the contractual reference for PG-01/PG-02 and the condenser design?
response: Confirmed: 16.0 degC remains the contractual Site Reference seawater temperature for all guarantees. The measured data in ALP-OWN-MAR-001 (annual mean 15.4 degC, range 6.9-27.0 degC) is the design range for the condenser and CW system. ER-02.03 is annotated accordingly.
subject: Site Reference seawater temperature 16.0 degC vs measured 15.4 degC
